title: Information Geometry and Asymptotic Theory for SMML Estimators
summary: Strict minimum message length (SMML) is an information-theoretic coding principle that represents a continuous statistical model by a finite set of assertions and a partition of the sample space. We show that the SMML objective decomposes into assertion entropy and conditional cross-entropy, balancing the cost of identifying an assertion against the cost of encoding data under the assigned model.
